question: Which Large Corporate clients with more than $25 million of active commitments have had no contact from any banker in the last 90 days?
answer:
**12 of the 38 Large Corporate clients with more than $25M of active commitments have had no banker contact in the last 90 days.** None of these 12 had any logged contact on or after 2026-07-02, so all of them breach the coverage standard (BR-COVER-01). Together they hold **$352.2M** of active commitments. All 12 have been without contact for at least 136 days, and five have gone more than 200 days.

| # | Client (CIF) | Active commitments | Last contact (any banker) | Days since | Primary RM (team) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Alderwick Health Inc (0000041139) | $27.9M | 2026-01-31 | 242 | Harper Garrow (C&I East) |
| 2 | Dunmore Technologies LLC (0000041178) | $38.1M | 2026-02-17 | 225 | Sawyer Rourke (C&I East) |
| 3 | Oakhurst Systems Inc (0000041445) | $26.5M | 2026-03-06 | 208 | Marlow Nolan (C&I West) |
| 4 | Ivorline Energy LLC (0000041313) | $29.6M | 2026-03-08 | 206 | Jordan Thorne (C&I East) |
| 5 | Brightwater Manufacturing LLC (0000041037) | $25.8M | 2026-03-14 | 200 | Sawyer Rourke (C&I East) |
| 6 | Brightwater Supply Co (0000041053) | $25.8M | 2026-03-23 | 191 | Sage Garrow (C&I East) |
| 7 | Valewood Technologies Inc (0000041615) | $26.2M | 2026-03-24 | 190 | Dana Abbott (C&I Central) |
| 8 | Glenhaven Properties Inc (0000041243) | $28.2M | 2026-03-28 | 186 | Sage Garrow (C&I East) |
| 9 | Stellmark-Orsa Ventures JV LLC (0000041099) | $30.0M | 2026-04-15 | 168 | Dana Abbott (C&I Central) |
| 10 | Eastvale Industries Co (0000041205) | $35.2M | 2026-04-26 | 157 | Gray Lowry (C&I East) |
| 11 | Alderwick Group Inc (0000041128) | $28.4M | 2026-05-10 | 143 | Jordan Thorne (C&I East) |
| 12 | Glenhaven Systems Inc (0000041251) | $30.5M | 2026-05-17 | 136 | Gray Lowry (C&I East) |

**Where the gaps are:**
- **By team:** C&I East has 9, C&I Central has 2 and C&I West has 1.
- **By RM:** Sage Garrow, Sawyer Rourke, Jordan Thorne, Gray Lowry and Dana Abbott each have 2. Harper Garrow and Marlow Nolan each have 1.
- **No coverage at all:** Alderwick Health, Dunmore, Valewood Technologies, Glenhaven Properties and Stellmark-Orsa JV have never had a contact from a treasury-management officer either. Their last relationship-manager contact is the only one on file.

**Things to know:**
- **Contacts by treasury-management officers count.** If only relationship-manager contacts counted, four more clients would be on the list: Larkspire Technologies (both CIFs), Oakhurst Manufacturing and Brightwater Distribution. They are covered because a treasury-management officer contacted them within the window.
- **Possible duplicate client record.** "Brightwater Manufacturing LLC" appears under two CIFs. 0000041037 is on the list; 0000041050 was contacted on 2026-08-26. It's worth checking whether these are duplicate records, because the contact may have been logged against the other CIF.
- **The list is per client, not per group.** Several names belong to wider groups (Alderwick, Glenhaven, Brightwater, Oakhurst, Valewood). That matches how the coverage standard is written, but group-level credit exposure would be different.

**Sources and definitions:**
- **Coverage standard:** business rule BR-COVER-01. Large Corporate clients with more than $25M of active commitments need a documented contact from a banker (relationship manager or product partner) at least every 90 days.
- **Tables (Client & Coverage data product, ratified):**
  - `BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT`, filtered to segment LC.
  - `BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY`: sum of committed amounts on ACTIVE facilities per CIF.
  - `BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT`: latest contact date per CIF across all banker roles, using the knowledge layer's approved Client-to-ClientContact join.
  - `BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_ROSTER`: names and teams for the primary RMs.
- **Assumptions:**
  - The 90-day window is counted back from 2026-09-30, so any contact before 2026-07-02 counts as a miss. No client falls near that cutoff; the closest are at 136 days (missed) and 75 days (covered).
  - Commitments are measured per client (CIF), as the rule states.
  - All 38 qualifying clients have ACTIVE status.
- **Policy:** No restrictions apply to RM_MANAGER for this analysis, and no columns were masked.

sql.sql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT cl.CIF_NO, cl.CLIENT_NM, cl.RM_ID, cl.CLIENT_STATUS, SUM(f.COMMIT_AMT) commit_amt, COUNT(*) n_fac
  FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT cl JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f ON f.CIF_NO=cl.CIF_NO
  WHERE cl.SEGMENT_CD='LC' AND f.FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE'
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 HAVING SUM(f.COMMIT_AMT) > 25000000),
lc AS (
  SELECT CIF_NO, MAX(CONTACT_DT) last_any, MAX(IFF(BANKER_ROLE='RM',CONTACT_DT,NULL)) last_rm,
         MAX(IFF(BANKER_ROLE<>'RM',CONTACT_DT,NULL)) last_other
  FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT WHERE CONTACT_DT <= '2026-09-30' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT c.*, r.RM_NM, r.TEAM, lc.last_any, lc.last_rm, lc.last_other,
  DATEDIFF(day, lc.last_any, '2026-09-30') days_since
FROM c LEFT JOIN lc ON lc.CIF_NO=c.CIF_NO LEFT JOIN BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_ROSTER r ON r.RM_ID=c.RM_ID
ORDER BY days_since DESC NULLS FIRST
